confirmed_from_paper.memory_entry: m = (z, d, e)  where e = abstracted experience (success pattern | failure-avoidance)
confirmed_from_paper.retrieval: 1) drop memory whose category != current category z; 2) semantic cosine(E(d_query), E(m.d)); 3) Top-1; forced (no threshold, no abstention); 4) inject e into the subtask-start context
confirmed_from_paper.update: 1) on subtask completion split the local trajectory; 2) same-model extractor evaluates; 3) success -> reusable pattern, failure -> failure-avoidance; 4) append a new memory entry
confirmed_from_paper.streaming: each arm/order starts empty; a target's experience is added only AFTER that target finishes; a task never reuses its own experience mid-run; extraction cost counts inside the total budget
confirmed_from_paper.metric: Avg. Pass@1 (mean +/- std over 3 runs); Best@3 also reported by the paper

reproduction_arms.AR0: VANILLA (author scaffold; no forced subtask transition; no historical memory) = paper 'Vanilla Agent'
reproduction_arms.AR2: INSTANCE_MEMORY (whole-task query; whole-trajectory/instance summary atom) = paper 'Instance-level (ReasoningBank)'
reproduction_arms.AR3: AUTHOR_SUBTASK_MEMORY (category + local intent; category hard-filter; semantic Top-1; abstract experience) = paper full method (+2.3..+6.8; mean +4.7)
reproduction_arms.AR4: NO_CATEGORY_FILTER (same entries; global atom search) = paper 'No Category Filter' (+1.6)
reproduction_arms.AR5: RAW_SUBTASK_TRAJECTORY (AR3 source/query; raw bounded subtask trajectory instead of e; token-matched) = paper 'Raw Trajectory' (+1.2)

reproduction_labels.AUTHOR_METHOD_REPRODUCED: AR3 > AR0 and AR2; prereg CI/stat rule pass; no integrity failure; direction stable across frozen orders
reproduction_labels.AUTHOR_METHOD_DIRECTIONAL: point estimate positive but CI includes 0
